description: This file declares functions, types, and macros for handling object identifiers (hashes) in hexadecimal, including conversions between binary and hex representations, parsing, and algorithm detection, as used within a version control context.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Reads a hexadecimal hash string and converts it into binary form based on the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop_r
methods.description: Converts binary hash data into a hexadecimal string using a provided buffer; reentrant version.

methods.name: oid_to_hex_r
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its hexadecimal string representation, writes result to provided buffer.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop
methods.description: Converts binary hash data to hexadecimal string using a static buffer.

methods.name: oid_to_hex
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its hex string using a static buffer.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string into an object ID structure, supporting a specific hash algorithm.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Detects and parses hex string into an object ID regardless of hash algorithm.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Parses hex string into object ID, detecting the hash algorithm used.

methods.name: get_hash_hex
methods.description: Converts a hex string into binary hash form using the current repository's hash algorithm.

methods.name: get_oid_hex
methods.description: Converts a hex string into object ID.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex
methods.description: Parses a hex string to an object ID using the current repository's hash algorithm.

methods.name: hash_to_hex
methods.description: Converts binary hash data into a hex string, using the current repository's hash algorithm.
